select p.id, p.project_code as "projectCode", p.project_name as "projectName", p.engineering_project as "engineeringProject", p.project_category_id as "projectCategoryId", p.client_unit as "clientUnit", p.contact_name as "contactName", p.contact_phone as "contactPhone", p.project_location as "projectLocation", p.contract_id as "contractId", p.status as "projectStatus", p.extra_data::text as "projectExtraData", p.assign_date as "assignDate", p.duration_require as "durationRequire", p.total_duration as "totalDuration", p.create_time as "createTime", p.close_time as "closeTime", p.remark as "remark", p.related_project_id as "relatedProjectId", rp.project_code as "relatedProjectCode", sl.submit_time as "submitTime", sl2.submit_time as "relatedLastSubmitTime", c.contract_no as "contractNo", c.contract_name as "contractName", c.contract_amount as "contractAmount", c.sign_date as "signDate", c.entrust_date as "entrustDate", c.audit_date as "auditDate", c.finish_date as "finishDate", c.archive_date as "archiveDate", c.contract_period as "contractPeriod", c.payment_terms as "paymentTerms", c.is_settled as "isSettled", c.extra_data::text as "contractExtraData", coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) as "receivedAmount", coalesce(pay_sum.refund_amount, 0) as "refundAmount", pay_sum.max_pay_time as "lastPayTime", coalesce(pay_sum.total_invoice, 0) as "totalInvoiceAmount", coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) as "projectSettleAmount", coalesce(w_sum.internal_output, 0) as "projectInternalOutput", greatest(coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) - coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0), 0) as "projectArrearsAmount", case when coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) > 0 then greatest(coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) - coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0), 0) else 0 end as "projectOverpaidAmount", leader.nick_name as "leaderName", cat.name as "categoryName", cat.parent_id as "categoryParentId" from proj_project p left join proj_contract c on c.id = p.contract_id and c.del_flag = '0'
left join proj_project rp on rp.id = p.related_project_id and rp.del_flag = '0'
left join proj_report_submit_log sl on sl.project_code = p.project_code and sl.del_flag = '0' left join proj_report_submit_log sl2 on sl2.project_code = rp.project_code and sl2.del_flag = '0' left join ( select project_id, sum(case when payment_type = 'refund' then -coalesce(amount, 0) else coalesce(amount, 0) end) as total_received, sum(case when payment_type = 'refund' then coalesce(amount, 0) else 0 end) as refund_amount, max(pay_time) as max_pay_time, sum(coalesce(invoice_amount, 0)) as total_invoice from proj_payment where del_flag = '0' group by project_id ) pay_sum on pay_sum.project_id = p.id left join ( select pl.project_id, min(su.nick_name) as nick_name from proj_leader pl left join sys_user su on su.user_id = pl.user_id group by pl.project_id ) leader on leader.project_id = p.id left join ( select project_id, sum(coalesce(external_output, 0)) as external_output, sum(coalesce(internal_output, 0)) as internal_output from proj_workload where del_flag = '0' group by project_id ) w_sum on w_sum.project_id = p.id left join proj_category cat on cat.id = p.project_category_id where p.del_flag = '0'
and p.project_code like concat('%', #{f.projectCode}, '%')
and p.project_name like concat('%', #{f.projectName}, '%')
and p.client_unit like concat('%', #{f.clientUnit}, '%')
and p.engineering_project = #{f.engineeringProject}
and p.project_location like concat('%', #{f.projectLocation}, '%')
and p.contact_name like concat('%', #{f.contactName}, '%')
and p.project_category_id = cast(#{f.categoryId} as bigint)
and p.contract_id = cast(#{f.contractId} as bigint)
and p.status in
#{s}
and p.assign_date >= cast(#{f.assignDateBegin} as date)
and p.assign_date <= cast(#{f.assignDateEnd} as date)
and p.create_time >= cast(#{f.createTimeBegin} as timestamp)
and p.create_time <= cast(#{f.createTimeEnd} as timestamp)
and p.close_time >= cast(#{f.closeTimeBegin} as timestamp)
and p.close_time < cast(#{f.closeTimeEnd} as date) + interval '1 day'
and c.sign_date >= cast(#{f.signDateBegin} as date)
and c.sign_date <= cast(#{f.signDateEnd} as date)
and c.entrust_date >= cast(#{f.entrustDateBegin} as date)
and c.entrust_date <= cast(#{f.entrustDateEnd} as date)
and c.audit_date >= cast(#{f.auditDateBegin} as date)
and c.audit_date <= cast(#{f.auditDateEnd} as date)
and pay_sum.max_pay_time >= cast(#{f.lastPayTimeBegin} as timestamp)
and pay_sum.max_pay_time <= cast(#{f.lastPayTimeEnd} as timestamp)
and c.contract_amount >= cast(#{f.contractAmountMin} as numeric)
and c.contract_amount <= cast(#{f.contractAmountMax} as numeric)
and pay_sum.total_received >= cast(#{f.receivedAmountMin} as numeric)
and pay_sum.total_received <= cast(#{f.receivedAmountMax} as numeric)
and coalesce(pay_sum.refund_amount, 0) >= cast(#{f.refundAmountMin} as numeric)
and coalesce(pay_sum.refund_amount, 0) <= cast(#{f.refundAmountMax} as numeric)
and (c.contract_amount - coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0)) >= cast(#{f.pendingAmountMin} as numeric)
and (c.contract_amount - coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0)) <= cast(#{f.pendingAmountMax} as numeric)
and coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) >= cast(#{f.projectSettleAmountMin} as numeric)
and coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) <= cast(#{f.projectSettleAmountMax} as numeric)
and (coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) - coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0)) >= cast(#{f.projectPendingAmountMin} as numeric)
and (coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) - coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0)) <= cast(#{f.projectPendingAmountMax} as numeric)
and greatest(coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) - coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0), 0) >= cast(#{f.projectArrearsAmountMin} as numeric)
and greatest(coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) - coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0), 0) <= cast(#{f.projectArrearsAmountMax} as numeric)
and case when coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) > 0 then greatest(coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) - coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0), 0) else 0 end >= cast(#{f.projectOverpaidAmountMin} as numeric)
and case when coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) > 0 then greatest(coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) - coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0), 0) else 0 end <= cast(#{f.projectOverpaidAmountMax} as numeric)
and coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) > 0 and coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) >= coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0)
and coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) > 0 and coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) > coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0)
and (coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) = 0 or coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) < coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0))
and coalesce(pay_sum.total_invoice, 0) >= cast(#{f.totalInvoiceAmountMin} as numeric)
and coalesce(pay_sum.total_invoice, 0) <= cast(#{f.totalInvoiceAmountMax} as numeric)
and c.archive_date >= cast(#{f.archiveDateBegin} as date)
and c.archive_date <= cast(#{f.archiveDateEnd} as date)
and c.finish_date >= cast(#{f.finishDateBegin} as date)
and c.finish_date <= cast(#{f.finishDateEnd} as date)
and coalesce(pay_sum.total_invoice, 0) > 0
and coalesce(pay_sum.total_invoice, 0) = 0
and c.contract_amount is not null and coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) >= c.contract_amount
and c.contract_amount is not null and coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) > c.contract_amount
and (c.contract_amount is null or coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) < c.contract_amount)
and c.finish_date is not null and extract(epoch from (now() - c.finish_date)) / 86400 / 30.44 >= cast(#{f.debtMonths} as numeric)
and p.contact_phone like concat('%', #{f.contactPhone}, '%')
and c.contract_no like concat('%', #{f.contractNo}, '%')
and c.contract_name like concat('%', #{f.contractName}, '%')
and c.contract_period like concat('%', #{f.contractPeriod}, '%')
and c.payment_terms like concat('%', #{f.paymentTerms}, '%')
and leader.nick_name like concat('%', #{f.leaderName}, '%')
and c.is_settled = #{f.isSettled}
and (p.project_code like concat('%', #{f.keyword}, '%') or p.project_name like concat('%', #{f.keyword}, '%') or p.client_unit like concat('%', #{f.keyword}, '%'))
order by p.id desc
